messages:
tasha: Heads-up: I'm filing an expedited hotfix for encoder routing that started causing intermittent 5xx for long inputs. No schema change. Built image encoder:v1.8.9-hotfix. Request: short lifeboat rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) in next 30m. Need quick approvals. /cc @liam_dev @oncall-ryan

liam_dev: Link the deploy and the exact rollback steps and confirm we can auto-pause if errors spike. Also need to know if this touches the kv-cache.

tasha: Deploy link: https://deploy.internal/redwood/deploys/1716239999 (CI: https://ci.internal/builds/8821). KV-cache untouched. Smoke tests green in staging. Perf: p95 +0.5% at worst. Rollback plan (manual + pin):
```
# rollback to prior image
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/encoder encoder=redwood/encoder:v1.8.8
# pin release-config to v1.8.8 to prevent accidental re-deploy
curl -X POST https://release-config.internal/pin -d '{"service":"encoder","version":"v1.8.8","reason":"rollback after hotfix"}'
```
I'll add a rollback playbook to the runbook channel.

deploybot: Received deploy request for encoder:v1.8.9-hotfix. CI status: ✅ unit, ✅ integration, e2e flaky (non-blocking). Proposed expedited canary: 10% for 4m, auto-pause if error_rate > 0.8% for 2m. Reply "approve" to continue or react :eyes:.

ci-bot: Quick flake note: last e2e failure unrelated to routing (timeout upstream).

ops-mig: Oncall, can we skip the 30m staggered canary? We keep a strict 4m gate and a rollback owner. I'm +1 if oncall is watching.

oncall-ryan: I'll be stood up and linked to pager for the next 45m. I'll also enable verbose logging for encoder traces. +1 from me, but we auto-pause at 0.8% error.

liam_dev: Adding circuit-breaker config now: error_threshold=0.8, consecutive_minutes=2. Also adding a metric to alert if tail-latency increases >10%.

tasha: done. Release note draft: "Hotfix: encoder routing fix reducing rare 5xx on long inputs. Version: v1.8.9-hotfix." Will publish on success.

ops-mig: deploybot: please ensure traffic-steering config uses lifeboat mode (keep previous pods warm).

deploybot: Canary started at 1716240005 -> encoder:v1.8.9-hotfix @10% traffic. Canary link: https://deploy.internal/redwood/deploys/1716239999/canary. Health gate: 4m.

tasha: Dashboard: https://grafana.company/d/encoder/encoder-health. If error_rate >0.8% for 2m we auto-pause and run rollback playbook.

liam_dev: Noted. I'll be on call for rollback steps, ready to execute kubectl if needed.

releasebot: Created draft release RN-467: "encoder v1.8.9-hotfix - routing fix (hotfix)". Will publish on completion.

ci-bot: Promoted logs: no increase in e2e failures during canary first 3m.

ops-mig: Canary steady at 3m: error_rate 0.2%, tail-latency stable. Proceed to 50% for 3m.

deploybot: Ramp to 50% at 1716240200.

liam_dev: monitoring: p95 +2% (within acceptable), error_rate 0.1%. All good.

oncall-ryan: watching traces, nothing abnormal.

ops-mig: Ramp to 100% at 1716240246.

deploybot: Rollout to 100% completed at 1716240250.

tasha: No rollback needed. Publishing release note and tagging ops. Thanks for the quick reviews everyone. :rocket:

releasebot: RN-467 published.

liam_dev: Quick follow-up: will open a small postmortem doc to track why routing drifted for long inputs. Not a full incident, but learning notes.

tasha: agreed, adding notes to the post-release checklist.

ops-mig: marking this hotfix as expedited in the deploy ledger.

releasebot: Deploy record updated: ledger entry L-9923 (expedited).
